C0211.title: Guangzhou Cross-Border E-Commerce Bonded Warehouse Click-Farm Tax Fraud Verdict Announced
C0211.summary: In May 2018, the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court delivered a verdict in a case involving click-farming through a cross-border bonded warehouse. A Guangzhou-based supply chain company used fabricated transactions to fraudulently obtain national tax incentives.
